about_the_game:
Start your adventure in Gensokyo right with the Gensokyo Safe Adventure Pack - 10x equipment and 5x consumables that will give you and your Touhou gals the fighting edge! The Gensokyo Safe Adventure Pack is available for FREE within the first two weeks of the game's launch!

The Gensokyo Safe Adventure Pack includes:

・Rare Yang Crystal x 1

・Rare Meteorite Shard x 1

・Rare Crystal Flower x 1

・Rare Ancient Card x 1

・Rare Helix Ritual Tool x 1

・Rare Warped Ring x 1

・Rare Foreign Charm x 1

・Rare Snowflake Badge x 1

・Rare Thin Feathers x 1

・Rare Shell Rosary x 1

・Rare Growth Elixir x 5

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 2.3GHz or AMD A9 2.9GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 2GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound (DirectX) compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i7 3770 or above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 970 or AMD RX 560 2GB equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound (DirectX) compatible sound card
